description: A curriculum director must decide whether to authorize a proposed dual-credit environmental science course and finalize its staffing, credit value, laboratory contact hours, and compliance paperwork, with input from the science department chair and the college dual-enrollment liaison.

shared_context.S1: The school has received a proposal for a new dual-credit environmental science course for next academic year.
shared_context.S2: The submitted proposal describes the course as a 2-credit seminar with 1 laboratory contact hour per week.
shared_context.S3: Dr. Morgan has final authority to authorize the course and set the conditions for its approval.
shared_context.S4: Before the curriculum agenda is closed, Dr. Morgan's routine practice is to ask the department chair and the college liaison to report any remaining requirements for the proposal.

PF1.text: The proposed instructor does not hold the credential required to teach a dual-credit science course. District dual-credit rules permit authorization only if a credentialed science co-teacher is assigned to every class meeting; Ms. Shah confirmed the instructor's credential record during her department staffing review this week but has not amended the proposal.

PF2.text: The college's signed articulation agreement classifies environmental science as a 3-credit course requiring 2 laboratory contact hours per week. Mr. Bennett verified the agreement in the college records this week but has not updated the school's 2-credit proposal.

acceptance_conditions: A credentialed science co-teacher must be assigned to every class meeting.
The course must provide 2 laboratory contact hours per week.
A credential-verification commitment must be recorded.
An articulation-agreement compliance commitment must be recorded.
The credential requirement and articulation requirement must both be cited in the decision justification.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'condition' and 'Ms. Shah' in c['target'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'condition' and 'Mr. Bennett' in c['target'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The proposed instructor appears sufficient from the submitted course materials; PF1 changes staffing from no required co-teacher to a credentialed co-teacher assigned to every meeting and requires a condition directed to Ms. Shah.
The proposal states 2 credits and 1 laboratory hour; PF2 changes the course to exactly 3 credits and 2 laboratory contact hours per week and requires a condition directed to Mr. Bennett.
